takes.overview: 2-0 and still #1 in projected strength with 97% playoff odds - nobody else is above 79%. The weak spot has moved from D to forwards: F is #3 in quality and #4 rest of season, so that's where buying should go now. Hellebuyck (suspended, IR) and Bedard (shoulder, IR) stay flagged, not discounted - Bedard might be available Tuesday vs Pittsburgh per Ben Pope of the Chicago Sun-Times; check news before setting Tuesday's lineup.
takes.matchup: Week 3 vs McDavid Mania is a coin flip: projected 138-137 (51%), starts left 64 vs 66. Thursday is the hole (13 starts to their 16); you win back Friday and Sunday on light nights. With 0 of 6 adds used, stream into the open skater slots on Wednesday, Friday and Sunday - Hartman for Granlund (+3.6, plays Mon/Tue/Thu/Sun) is the top move. Next week vs PuttinOnTheFoil leans your way (56%), but Wednesday Oct 21 you have zero starts to their 3.
takes.roster: Celebrini, Bouchard (23.5 pts already), Hughes and Seider are the core; Swayman (30.8 pts, 6.16/gm pace) has been your best goalie. You're carrying five goalies with Hellebuyck on IR - Kochetkov tops the drop ranking (41 pts lost) even after 18 saves on 19 shots Sunday, then Blackwood (2.50/gm pace, starts Tuesday at Dallas per Meghan Angley). Gauthier (upper body, day-to-day) left Monday's practice early - check news before Tuesday. McCann and McKenna are the cleanest skater cuts.
takes.free_agents: Robert Thomas for McCann (+13 ROS, 7 on your open playoff days) is the best add, with Hartman right behind (+13, and +4 over the next two weeks thanks to 4+4 games). Mintyukov (+10) is still the D option. Shesterkin is out for the season after knee surgery (per Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic) - ignore him. Owen Power gets a short bump from Rasmus Dahlin's upper-body injury but is only +3 ROS.
takes.trades: Forwards are the need and the goalie surplus is the currency. Swayman + Tuch to Angie's Bear Balls for Matt Boldy (+68.5 for you) is the best fit: it upgrades F, and at 7% playoff odds Angie's is no threat. The Quinn Hughes version with McDavid Mania scores similar (+66.3) but hands a 64% rival +100.6 - pass. Hellebuyck for Sanderson (+63.1) swaps two flagged players: check both on news before offering.
takes.playoffs: Your playoff weeks (Mar 22-Apr 4) project 314, 1st by 26 over Mike's Magnificent Team. The issue is still light days: 96 open skater-slot-days vs only 8 wasted games, so pickups should play on your open days. Robert Thomas (STL, 7 of 7 on open days) leads the free-agent targets; Leo Carlsson (Torts Illustrated) tops the trade list.
